cohort: 29 women with chronic pelvic pain associated with trigger points after a caesarean section
finding: Women with chronic pelvic pain and abnormal electromyography findings after caesarean section experienced significantly greater pain reduction following trigger point injections compared to those with normal electromyography findings, suggesting a neuropathic origin for their pain.
mod_finding: The study focuses on pain after caesarean section, implying a mode of delivery of caesarean section.
